facts.fact: The law firm Z. Mayet and Associates states that the Data Protection Act (Act 5 of 2012) establishes a Data Protection Commission, but that the Commission and its Commissioner have not been appointed, so the regulator does not exist in practice; no event date is given, so this is as at the document's publication date of 2025-10-31.

note: Rulings: the document says only that courts may award damages, which is not the authority's ruling, so no rulings fact.
